question: In 2D, the Yee (standard FDTD) solver of the PIC code WarpX must satisfy the Courant condition c·dt ≤ 1/√(1/dx²+1/dz²). For a uniform grid with dx=dz=1 μm, what is the maximum timestep allowed by CFL, expressed as the dimensionless CFL number c·dt/dx?

question: For relativistically streaming plasmas, which standard combination does the WarpX documentation recommend to suppress the numerical Cherenkov instability (NCI)?

options.A: Apply a Godfrey/bilinear filter to the electromagnetic fields (filtering before gather) together with the Vay particle pusher or Galilean coordinates
options.C: Switch to fully implicit particle pushing

options_zh.A: 对电磁场施加 Godfrey/bilinear 滤波(gather 前滤波)并配合 Vay 粒子推进器或 Galilean 坐标
options_zh.B: 简单把网格加密 10 倍

question: Why does WarpX default to the Esirkepov current-deposition scheme instead of a plain charge-conserving area-density post-processing?

options.A: The Esirkepov scheme constructs currents on the Yee grid according to the continuity equation, guaranteeing discrete charge conservation (no extra divergence cleaning needed) and consistency with the FDTD ∇·E=ρ/ε₀ relation

options_zh.A: Esirkepov 格式在 Yee 网格上按连续性方程构造电流,保证离散电荷守恒(无需额外散度修正),与 FDTD 的 ∇·E=ρ/ε₀ 一致性相容
options_zh.D: 它能提高粒子能量精度

metadata.source: Esirkepov 2001 电流沉积格式(公开论文);WarpX 文档
metadata.notes: 电荷守恒型沉积的物理意义

options_en.A: The Esirkepov scheme constructs currents on the Yee grid according to the continuity equation, guaranteeing discrete charge conservation (no extra divergence cleaning needed) and consistency with the FDTD ∇·E=ρ/ε₀ relation

question: In DESC issue #1940, plot_fsa of lambda for a symmetric equilibrium disagrees with a manual field-line calculation. Which statement about the flux-surface average definition is correct?

options.A: The flux-surface average is ⟨f⟩=∮ f dl/B / ∮ dl/B (a 1/B-weighted average along a closed field line); in the symmetric case it must agree with analytic formulas, and implementation discrepancies usually come from the coordinate system or the weighting factor
options.B: The flux-surface average is just a plain volume average
options.C: Flux-surface averages are defined only in stellarators, meaningless in tokamaks
options.D: lambda is an arbitrary constant unrelated to the equilibrium

options_zh.A: 通面平均 ⟨f⟩=∮ f dl/B / ∮ dl/B(沿闭合磁力线的 1/B 加权平均),对称情形下应与解析公式严格一致;实现差异往往源于坐标系或加权因子
options_zh.B: 通面平均就是对体积的简单平均
options_zh.C: 通面平均只在仿星器中定义,托卡马克中无意义
options_zh.D: λ 是任意常数,与平衡无关

question: Why do gyrokinetic turbulence simulations (e.g. GS2) mainly use the δf (perturbed distribution) method?

options.A: Turbulent fluctuation amplitudes are much smaller than the equilibrium distribution; evolving the full f would lose precision, while δf evolves only the small perturbation with lower numerical noise
options.B: δf is more expensive but simpler

options_zh.A: 湍流涨落幅值远小于平衡分布,直接对全量 f 演化会损失精度;δf 只需演化小扰动,数值噪声更低
options_zh.B: δf 方法计算量更大但更简单
options_zh.C: 全量 f 无法写成代码
options_zh.D: δf 是为了避免磁场项

metadata.source: 回旋动理学公开教科书/综述(δf vs full-f)
